# AI platform and operating model

English · [Русский](../ru/themes/ai-operating-model.md) · ← [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md)

Internal AI platforms, adoption across an organisation, enablement, cost governance and centres of excellence.

## Both tracks

- **How would you support multiple model providers when some deployment environments permit only a subset of models?**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether a platform preserves deployment constraints and makes capability gaps visible.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Make environment policy and data restrictions explicit in model selection.
    - Define a portable interface without pretending all models have identical capabilities.
    - Evaluate allowed fallbacks and fail closed when no compliant route exists.
  - Read: [Architect multitenant solutions on Azure](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/guide/multitenant/overview) (Microsoft Learn) · [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) (NIST)
- **How would you evaluate an enterprise AI assistant when your team cannot inspect customer data?**
  - System design · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you can obtain useful quality evidence within data-access restrictions.
- **Design a service that lets several teams query a shared dataset without exposing the underlying raw records.**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you define permissible results and enforce access across a shared platform.

## AI Leadership

- **Define a strategy for an internal AI platform, including who owns its success metrics.**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Stripe](../companies/stripe.md) †
  - Tests: Whether platform investment is tied to internal customer outcomes and clear ownership.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Identify recurring needs across teams and where a shared service adds value.
    - Separate platform reliability and adoption from the business outcomes owned by consuming teams.
    - Choose a first supported workflow, service boundaries and a review of continued investment.
  - Read: [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google) · [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research)
